    AI Overview
    Yes, Hannah Montana is "coming back" for a 20th Anniversary Special on Disney+, premiering March 24, 2026, where Miley Cyrus revisits the show with recreated sets and archival footage, featuring an interview with Alex Cooper, but it's a retrospective, not a new series with new episodes.
     
    This video shows a first look at the Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special:
    17s
    Entertainment Tonight
    YouTube · Mar 10, 2026
    What to expect in the special:
    • Miley Cyrus returns:
      She'll be back in the iconic wig, revisiting sets like the Stewart family living room and Hannah's closet. 
    • Interviews:
      A sit-down interview with Miley and host Alex Cooper (from Call Her Daddy) will explore the show's impact. 
    • Nostalgia:
      Expect never-before-seen footage, recreations of iconic moments, and "familiar notes" (music). 
    • Family reunion:
      Her parents, Tish and Billy Ray Cyrus, also appear, reenacting moments from the show. 
    Key Details: 
    • Title: Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special
    • Release Date: March 24, 2026 (exactly 20 years after the original premiere)
    • Platform: Disney+

      Is Miley Cyrus coming back as Hannah Montana?

      AI Overview
      Yes, Miley Cyrus is "bringing back" Hannah Montana for "The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special," streaming March 24, 2026, on Disney+, featuring her on recreated sets, revisiting iconic moments, and alongside her father, Billy Ray Cyrus, celebrating the show that launched her career.
       
      This video shows the first trailer for the special:
      51s
      LA Times Studios
      YouTube · Mar 12, 2026
      What to Expect:
      • A Look Back:
        The special is a retrospective, not a new series, focusing on the show's impact and the memories from its run. 
      • Familiar Faces & Places:
        Cyrus returns to the iconic Steuart family living room and her rotating closet set, wearing a Hannah Montana-style outfit. 
      • Special Guests:
        Her real-life father, Billy Ray Cyrus, who played her dad on the show, appears with her in the trailer. 
      • Interviews:
        Alex Cooper of Call Her Daddy hosts, with Cyrus reflecting on the show's legacy and the generation it defined. 
      You can also watch this video for a look at the special:

        AI Overview
        Disney+ in February 2026 brought new Muppet specials, Season 2 of The Artful Dodger, animated series like RoboGobo S2 and Armorsaurs, plus documentaries and reality shows from National Geographic and Hulu, with a special Hannah Montana stream and Incas: The Rise and Fall also premiering. Highlights included a Muppet revival special with Sabrina Carpenter and Seth Rogen, and themed content for Hannah Montana's 20th anniversary.
         
        Key Releases & Premieres:
        • The Muppet Show (Disney+ Original): A special event celebrating the 50th anniversary, featuring guest stars like Sabrina Carpenter. 
        • The Artful Dodger (Season 2): The Hulu Original series continues. 
        • Hannah Montana: A 24/7 stream with episodes, movies, and concerts for the 20th anniversary. 
        • RoboGobo (Season 2): The animated superhero series returns. 
        • Armorsaurs: A new animated series premiere. 
        • Incas: The Rise and Fall: A documentary series. 
        Documentaries & Reality: Ancient Aliens (Season 17), History's Greatest Mysteries (Season 6), We Call It Imagineering, and Storage Wars (Season 16). 
        Other Series & Shorts: 
        • Hey A.J.!
        • Chibi Tiny Tales (Season 7)
        • Cartoonified! with Phineas and Ferb
        Hulu Content (via Disney+ in some regions): The Artful Dodger (Season 2), Ghostbusters: Afterlife, and Keeping Up with the Kardashians (Various Seasons). 
        Note: Content availability can vary by region and is subject to change.
